source.snippet: I'm working on an application that integrates with multiple LLM providers (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini). Right now, the application calls each provider's API directly, and while this works, it's becoming harder to manage as we add more models and AI-powered features. Challenges: Managing API keys and authentication securely; Rate limiting and usage control; Logging requests and responses for monitoring; Tracking token usage and costs across providers...

problem_statement: Engineering teams integrating multiple LLM providers face growing operational overhead: fragmented API key management, inconsistent rate-limiting, missing cost visibility, and no unified audit log — with no lightweight self-hostable solution that handles all of this together.
target_segment: Software development teams and agencies at small-to-mid-size companies building AI-powered features across multiple LLM providers.
notes: Poster is a paying customer of multiple LLM APIs and spending engineering time on glue code. Pain compounds as model count grows. Existing solutions (LiteLLM, Portkey, etc.) exist but the question signals the market is still searching — either existing tools are too complex, too expensive, or not self-hostable. Opportunity: a dead-simple AI gateway (SaaS or one-click deploy) focused on cost visibility + key rotation + audit logs for teams of 2–20 engineers.
